neighbours.label: the digits and decimal point of a number reported as a mean or average ('mean age was 36▁.▁7', 'averaging 79▁.▁9'); not other decimals
fire: The mean height of the seedlings after six weeks was 14.6 centimetres.
Patients stayed in hospital for a mean of 9.3 days after surgery.
The average commute in the county now takes 27.5 minutes.
This season the guard is averaging 18.7 points and six rebounds.
Average household size in the district was 2.8 people.
The mean score on the reading test was 71.4 out of a hundred.
On average the hens laid 5.2 eggs a week during the trial.
The average rainfall for April over the decade was 63.9 millimetres.
quiet: The tallest seedling after six weeks measured 14.6 centimetres.
The ward is on floor 9, room 3, next to the surgery wing.
The bus to the county seat leaves at 7.45 from platform two.
The guard signed a contract worth 18.7 million dollars.
The house in the district sold for 2.8 million pounds.
The radio station broadcasts on 71.4 megahertz.
The hens were fed 5.2 kilograms of grain on Monday.
The bridge over the river is 63.9 metres long.

notes: Card: '.' x12 and digits inside figures that follow mean/average/averaging. Probes: 'mean age … 42.3' 0.62, 'Average tenure … 6.8' 0.66, 'averaging 81.4' 0.38, 'median income 51.2' 0.32; 'weighs 42.3' 0.02, 'costs 81.4' 0.02, 'Version 6.8' 0.01. An integer mean (42 years) also fired 0.62, so it is the value, not the decimal point as such.
